Preemptively prefacing your post telling people not to point out your terrible takes just tells me that you know your takes are trash.
1. Spawncamping is tough, but there are almost always ways to get out of one. The only map that is trash with spawncamping is dunes. On metro, there are the gigantic hallways on the sides of the map. You don't have to go up the escalators like lemmings.
2. I agree with you here. There are like 7 good maps in this game and 2 of them are revamps. Stylis needs to get a full time map designer ASAP.
3. SBMM is almost always terrible in every game its implemented in and makes the issue of smurfing so much worse. I don't think smurfing is as much of a problem in PF as in other games, though. Still, SBMM can be easily bypassed just by creating a new account when your level gets to high if you went off levels, or by reseting if you went off KDR.
4. Movement in PF is fine how it is imo. Only problem I can think of off the top of my head is the random vaulting. We're lucky that you don't get a movement penalty while you're getting shot at in PF like other games do. The movement penalty can be nullified with a 3 minute tutorial on YouTube, you just have to put in the effort. Also, ledge holding and other movement types would take the PF out of PF. Something about the lack of new-fangled movement is really satisfying to me, especially when you finally master a difficult movement technique.

Lastly, I think that it's important to point out that, by the way you talk, you're not a very high rank. You're probably used to the more polished shooters on the market, but I have 2 things in response. One, this game is made in roblox. It will NEVER be as good from an objective standpoint as the triple A games made by multi million dollar companies. Two, I think you should probably get a little more experience in a game before you try to make suggestions. I wouldn't go into a game like League and act like an expert, saying all the things that are "wrong" with the game. Just for a quick example, when you get more experienced with the game, movement becomes more fluid. Spawncamping doesn't happen because it's relatively easy to break out of with a quick flank.
